title: Psalm 108
opening_line: My heart is fixed, Lord; I will sing,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: My heart is fixed, Lord; I will sing,
text.normalized: My heart is fixed, Lord; I will sing,
text.reading: My heart is fixed, Lord; I will sing,

text.diplomatic: and with my glory praise.
text.normalized: And with my glory praise.
text.reading: and with my glory praise.

text.diplomatic: Awake up psaltery and harp;
text.normalized: Awake up psaltery and harp;
text.reading: Awake up psaltery and harp;

text.diplomatic: myself I’ll early raise.
text.normalized: Myself I’ll early raise.
text.reading: myself I’ll early raise.

text.diplomatic: I’ll praise thee ’mong the people, LORD;
text.normalized: I’ll praise thee ’mong the people, LORD;
text.reading: I’ll praise thee ’mong the people, LORD;

text.diplomatic: ’mong nations sing will I:
text.normalized: ’Mong nations sing will I:
text.reading: ’mong nations sing will I:

text.diplomatic: For above heav’n thy mercy’s great,
text.normalized: For above heav’n thy mercy’s great,
text.reading: For above heav’n thy mercy’s great,

text.diplomatic: thy truth doth reach the sky.
text.normalized: Thy truth doth reach the sky.
text.reading: thy truth doth reach the sky.

text.diplomatic: Be thou above the heavens, Lord,
text.normalized: Be thou above the heavens, Lord,
text.reading: Be thou above the heavens, Lord,

text.diplomatic: exalted gloriously;
text.normalized: Exalted gloriously;
text.reading: exalted gloriously;

text.diplomatic: Thy glory all the earth above
text.normalized: Thy glory all the earth above
text.reading: Thy glory all the earth above

text.diplomatic: be lifted up on high.
text.normalized: Be lifted up on high.
text.reading: be lifted up on high.

text.diplomatic: That those who thy belovèd are
text.normalized: That those who thy belovèd are
text.reading: That those who thy belovèd are

text.diplomatic: deliverèd may be,
text.normalized: Deliverèd may be,
text.reading: deliverèd may be,

text.diplomatic: O do thou save with thy right hand,
text.normalized: O do thou save with thy right hand,
text.reading: O do thou save with thy right hand,

text.diplomatic: and answer give to me.
text.normalized: And answer give to me.
text.reading: and answer give to me.

text.diplomatic: God in his holiness hath said,
text.normalized: God in his holiness hath said,
text.reading: God in his holiness hath said,

text.diplomatic: Herein I will take pleasure;
text.normalized: Herein I will take pleasure;
text.reading: Herein I will take pleasure;

text.diplomatic: Shechem I will divide, and forth
text.normalized: Shechem I will divide, and forth
text.reading: Shechem I will divide, and forth

text.diplomatic: will Succoth’s valley measure.
text.normalized: Will Succoth’s valley measure.
text.reading: will Succoth’s valley measure.

text.diplomatic: Gilead I claim as mine by right;
text.normalized: Gilead I claim as mine by right;
text.reading: Gilead I claim as mine by right;

text.diplomatic: Manasseh mine shall be;
text.normalized: Manasseh mine shall be;
text.reading: Manasseh mine shall be;

text.diplomatic: Ephraim is of my head the strength;
text.normalized: Ephraim is of my head the strength;
text.reading: Ephraim is of my head the strength;

text.diplomatic: Judah gives laws for me;
text.normalized: Judah gives laws for me;
text.reading: Judah gives laws for me;

text.diplomatic: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe
text.normalized: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe
text.reading: Moab’s my washing-pot; my shoe

text.diplomatic: I’ll over Edom throw;
text.normalized: I’ll over Edom throw;
text.reading: I’ll over Edom throw;

text.diplomatic: Over the land of Palestine
text.normalized: Over the land of Palestine
text.reading: Over the land of Palestine

text.diplomatic: I will in triumph go.
text.normalized: I will in triumph go.
text.reading: I will in triumph go.

text.diplomatic: O who is he will bring me to
text.normalized: O who is he will bring me to
text.reading: O who is he will bring me to

text.diplomatic: the city fortified?
text.normalized: The city fortified?
text.reading: the city fortified?

text.diplomatic: O who is he that to the land
text.normalized: O who is he that to the land
text.reading: O who is he that to the land

text.diplomatic: of Edom will me guide?
text.normalized: Of Edom will me guide?
text.reading: of Edom will me guide?

text.diplomatic: O God, thou who hadst cast us off,
text.normalized: O God, thou who hadst cast us off,
text.reading: O God, thou who hadst cast us off,

text.diplomatic: this thing wilt thou not do?
text.normalized: This thing wilt thou not do?
text.reading: this thing wilt thou not do?

text.diplomatic: And wilt not thou, ev’n thou, O God,
text.normalized: And wilt not thou, ev’n thou, O God,
text.reading: And wilt not thou, ev’n thou, O God,

text.diplomatic: forth with our armies go?
text.normalized: Forth with our armies go?
text.reading: forth with our armies go?

text.diplomatic: Do thou from trouble give us help,
text.normalized: Do thou from trouble give us help,
text.reading: Do thou from trouble give us help,

text.diplomatic: for helpless is man’s aid.
text.normalized: For helpless is man’s aid.
text.reading: for helpless is man’s aid.

text.diplomatic: Through God we shall do valiantly;
text.normalized: Through God we shall do valiantly;
text.reading: Through God we shall do valiantly;

text.diplomatic: our foes he shall down tread.
text.normalized: Our foes he shall down tread.
text.reading: our foes he shall down tread.
